name: structure-health
description: Structure Health CLI surface. Single source of truth for the `validate` domain: schema-validated against cli-manifest/v1 and cross-validated against the ValidationService proto descriptor at test time. Loaded by cli/main.go via cliapp.LoadFromManifest.

groups.name: validate
groups.description: Validate scenario structure and lifecycle wiring

commands.name: scenario
commands.description: Validate a scenario's skeleton and lifecycle wiring by reconciling code-facts ground truth against declared service.json intent

flags.name: path
flags.description: Filesystem path to validate instead of a scenario slug

groups.name: fleet
groups.description: Deterministic offender queries over the whole fleet's structure conformance

commands.name: scan
commands.description: Roll up structure conformance across every discovered scenario (or a requested subset): per-scenario rollups, profile distribution, per-rule conformance, and auto-fixable coverage

flags.name: scenario
flags.description: Restrict the scan to one or more scenario slugs (repeatable / comma-separated); default scans every discovered scenario

groups.name: perf
groups.description: Benchmark scenario startup performance and read the persisted trend (decoupled from validation; never run by a test phase)

commands.name: measure
commands.description: Restart a scenario and record its startup performance (time-to-healthy + resource envelope) to the persisted trend. This restarts the target scenario.

flags.name: timeout
flags.description: Max seconds to wait for the scenario to report healthy (0 = default)

commands.name: trend
commands.description: Read a scenario's persisted startup-performance measurements, newest first

positionals.name: scenario
positionals.description: Scenario slug to read the trend for

groups.name: fix-config
groups.description: Preview or apply deterministic structure and service.json fixes

commands.name: run
commands.description: Preview (or, with --apply, apply) deterministic structure/service.json fixes for a scenario's auto-fixable findings

flags.name: rule
flags.description: Restrict fixes to one or more finding codes (repeatable / comma-separated)

flags.name: path
flags.description: Filesystem path to repair instead of a scenario slug

flags.name: apply
flags.description: Apply the fixes (default is a dry-run preview)

commands.name: apply
commands.description: Apply deterministic structure/service.json fixes for a scenario's auto-fixable findings

flags.name: rule
flags.description: Restrict fixes to one or more finding codes (repeatable / comma-separated)

flags.name: path
flags.description: Filesystem path to repair instead of a scenario slug

omitted.reason: Shared cross-scenario validation surface exposed alongside this scenario's own ValidationService; the CLI 'validate scenario' command targets the scenario-local ValidationService.
